name: diting-agent
description: Evidence-driven performance trace analysis for cold start, response latency, completion latency, and frame jank.

interface.longDescription: DitingAgent turns a .htrace capture plus a symptom description into a traceable performance diagnosis. It converts the trace with the bundled Trace Streamer, exposes bounded read-only trace tools, routes to the matching scenario methodology (cold start, response latency, completion latency, frame jank), correlates perf samples with the critical path, and renders a self-contained HTML report with evidence IDs. This plugin ships that methodology plus the CLI workflow so any Codex session can drive an analysis and read the result.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this htrace for cold-start latency
Find the dropped frames in this scroll trace
